title: Samuel's Armor Trim Surcoats
description: This resource pack changes the armor trims to surcoat-like patterns.
body:
This resource changes the armor trim designs into Surcoats, for better armor customization. Each smithing template has their own unique design, and each smithing ingredient has two colors.
I had been wanting something like this for a while, and when armor trims came out, I started to make this. Now I want to share it with anyone who wants it.
